groups.description: Release groups. A package belongs to one group at most. The first group is the default one.

docs.description: Sync the docs into NanoForge-dev/docs after each release: docs/docs and docs/guides (each with its navigation.json) replace docs/<category> and guides/<category>

group.description: Group whose releases sync the docs. Default: the first group

category.description: Docs category, the folder name in the docs repo: engine, cli, loader, editor... (a-z, 0-9 and -)

references.description: Generate the API references (pnpm run docs) and publish them under references/<category>/<version>, keeping the highest version of each major

referencesPath.description: Directory the docs script writes: pages and a navigation.json

mode.description: all: every package at once; single: one package per release; some: any subset chosen at dispatch

versioning.description: shared: one version and one tag for the release; independent: one version and one tag per package

npm.description: Publish the non-private packages on npm

githubRelease.description: Create a GitHub release (else a tag only)

latest.description: Mark the GitHub release as latest. Default: true when shared

branchFormat.description: Default: releases/{name}@{version} (shared), releases/{name}/{run} (independent). Must start with releases/

commitFormat.description: Commit message and PR title. Default: chore({name}): release {name}@{version} (shared), chore({name}): release {packages} (independent)

majorTag.description: Also move the v<major> tag to the release

betaOnMerge.description: Publish a beta on npm when a non-release PR is merged
